title: Minimum Cost Path With Even XOR Parity
statement: The task is to find, in a weighted tree of up to 10^5 nodes, the cheapest path between two distinct nodes whose XOR of node values has an even number of set bits, or -1. Popcount parity of an XOR is the XOR of each value's popcount parity, so each node becomes a 0/1 bit and a tree DP tracks the cheapest downward path of each parity.
